column3: MT 12:2. “All the day” is rendered “continually”; NASB adds “Moreover.”
MT 12:3. “Case at law” is rendered “dispute,” and “visit” “punish.”
MT 12:5. “Struggled against an angel” is rendered “wrestled with the angel,” and “sought favor to him” “sought His favor”; NASB adds “Yes.”
MT 12:7. “In your God you will return” is rendered “return to your God,” and “loyalty” “kindness”; NASB adds “Therefore.”
MT 12:9. “People will not find to me” is rendered “they will find in me”; NASB adds “would be.”
MT 12:10. “From the land of Egypt” is rendered “since the land of Egypt.”
MT 12:11. “Multiplied visions” is rendered “gave numerous visions.”
MT 12:12. “If Gilead is wickedness” is rendered “Is there iniquity in Gilead?”; “on the furrows” is rendered “Beside the furrows.”
MT 12:13. “Region” is rendered “land,” and “served” “worked”; NASB supplies “sheep.”
